WITH lab_patient AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    p.SEX,
    l.PT,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL 
      THEN l.IGA - l.IGM 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS iga_minus_igm
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX != ''
),
patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(PT) as avg_pt,
    AVG(iga_minus_igm) as avg_iga_minus_igm
  FROM lab_patient
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) as overall_iga_minus_igm_mean
  FROM patient_avgs
),
patient_with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.ID,
    pa.SEX,
    pa.avg_pt,
    pa.avg_iga_minus_igm,
    pa.avg_iga_minus_igm / om.overall_iga_minus_igm_mean as ratio
  FROM patient_avgs pa, overall_mean om
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  AVG(avg_pt) as avg_pt,
  AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) as avg_iga_minus_igm,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
FROM patient_with_ratio
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX
